**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject explicit sequences whose first surviving row is a continuation**

When table extraction drops a question’s first row but still returns a later label such as `8(ii)` or `8(b)`, this unconditionally treats that continuation as the root. Because `ms_question_headers()` only checks that every question number appears somewhere, it will select the explicit path and produce a crop beginning at the later subpart, silently omitting the start of the mark scheme answer instead of failing closed.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require the preserved-v2 custody set to be nonempty**

When `--preserved-external-root` is wrong or its three expected subdirectories are empty, `tree_custody()` returns zero-file manifests and the later compatibility loops also compare zero files, yet the receipt still records `additive_write_once_compatibility_passed: true`. This allows the evidence builder to issue a passing preservation receipt without checking any of the expected 113 packets, 113 manifests, or 151 frozen inputs.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Check duplicate implicit labels across continuation pages**

When a borderless question spans multiple pages, a repeated question digit aligned with the selected column on a later page is excluded solely because `row["page"]` differs from the root page. The sequence is therefore accepted even though that later digit may be a duplicate root or competing formula before the next question header, so the implicit locator is not uniquely supported and does not fail closed as intended.
